M/s Surat Diamonds Trading Co

GSTIN: 24AABCS3344M1ZQ

Subject: Show Cause Notice under Section 73(1) of the CGST Act, 2017 read with Section 20 of the IGST Act, 2017 — Apparent suppression of outward supplies and wrongful availment of ITC for FY 2023-24.

Sir,

It has been observed during the audit conducted under Section 65 of the CGST Act, 2017 that:

1. Outward taxable supplies aggregating Rs. 1,24,50,000/- have been suppressed in GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B for FY 2023-24, leading to short payment of IGST of Rs. 22,41,000/-.

2. Ineligible Input Tax Credit of Rs. 4,80,000/- has been availed on:
   (a) Invoices issued by suppliers whose GST registration was cancelled prior to the date of invoice [Section 16(2)(b)]
   (b) Personal/non-business expenses booked in the company's name

3. Discrepancy between e-way bills generated and GSTR-1 disclosures indicates suppression.

The total demand including tax, interest and penalty is computed as follows:

   TAX (IGST short paid):       Rs. 22,41,000
   TAX (Ineligible ITC):        Rs.  4,80,000
   ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   Sub-total tax:               Rs. 27,21,000

   Interest under Section 50:   Rs.  4,89,780  (18% p.a.)
   Penalty under Section 73(9): Rs.  2,72,100  (10% of tax)
   ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   GRAND TOTAL:                 Rs. 34,82,880

NOW THEREFORE, you are required to show cause within 30 (thirty) days as to why:

(a) The aforesaid amount along with applicable interest should not be recovered under Section 73(1) of the CGST Act, 2017
(b) Penalty under Section 73(9) should not be imposed
(c) Any other action under the CGST Act, IGST Act and CGST Rules should not be initiated

Reply in Form GST DRC-06 on the common portal. Personal hearing may be requested.

(signed)
Superintendent of Central Tax
Ward 12, Ahmedabad West
